tools.name: vorim_get_plans
tools.description: Get an overview of Vorim AI plan tiers. Vorim uses usage-based pricing metered on audit events (every signed agent action). Returns the per-tier event volume, agent caps, and audit retention. Paid pricing is custom; directs to contact for details.

tools.name: vorim_get_product_overview
tools.description: Get a plain-language overview of what Vorim AI is: the identity, permissions, and audit layer for AI agents. Returns the product summary, key links, and the underlying open protocol.

tools.name: vorim_list_permission_scopes
tools.description: List the permission scopes Vorim supports for AI agents. These are the scoped, least-privilege permissions that can be granted to an agent and checked at tool-call time.

tools.name: vorim_list_sdks
tools.description: List the Vorim AI SDKs and packages an agent or developer can install, including the TypeScript SDK, Python SDK, MCP server, and CLI.
